o: The Vision, rebooted and having escaped from those who sought to weaponize him, has been in hiding. Searching for new meaning, he consults the AI personas embedded in his programming, including Friday, Edith, Jarvis, and the infamous Ultron. His discreet existence ends when a bounty placed on his head thrusts him on the run with Thomas Shepherd, a mysterious boy who may be Vision's son…

v.n: A Birthday Surprise for Ruaridh Mollica from “Dad” Paul…

eps.o: Vision embarks on a journey of self-discovery and finds himself haunted by a deadly force.
Vision comes face to face with his assailant while investigating whether Tommy Shepherd is his son.
Vision and Tommy Shepherd join forces in order to survive while a terrifying killer strikes again.
As Vision confronts a new enemy, Ultron and Tommy Shepherd come face to face.
